meta.title: Daisy Bell
meta.subtitle: A bicycle built for two — into old London
meta.pitch: Rubella and Lillith ride a living flower bicycle from a modern wildflower field straight into period London. The joke is the bike. The experiment is the cut: scratchy black-and-white film grain flipping into crisp HD color and back, as if the century cannot settle.
meta.constant: Core lock: black-lace Rubella + Lillith (field still look) · tandem fully covered in living wildflowers (slightly too alive) · Fleet Street energy with St. Paul’s deep in background. Stylish 1890–96 = leg-of-mutton + feathered hats; working class = patched wool, no decoration. Prototype gen: 1280×720, 50 steps.

subjectLock: two glamorous modern women (Rubella and Lillith) with long dark hair, blood-red lipstick, body-conscious slightly sheer black lace evening dresses with no corset hourglass, no leg-of-mutton sleeves, no towering hats, modern gothic fashion dropped into the wrong century, riding a tandem bicycle whose entire frame, wheels, handlebars and seat are completely covered in living wildflowers and green vines, bright multicolored blooms slightly too alive, no bare metal visible on the bicycle, period London street with Fleet Street energy, dome of St. Paul's Cathedral deep in the background
stylish1890s: 1890-1896 fashionable women with extreme hourglass corseted waists, leg-of-mutton gigot sleeves massive at the shoulder tapering to the wrist, high standing collars, gored A-line skirts clearing the ground, large heavily decorated hats with feathers ribbons flowers, Gibson Girl pompadour hair, tailored walking suits in silk and wool, polished rigid period elegance
working1890s: 1890s working-class figures in heavy worn wool and coarse cotton, faded dark colors, patched dusty functional clothes, women in long plain skirts shawls practical boots headscarves, men in cloth caps waistcoats heavy jackets boots, no giant sleeves no decoration

sequence.title: Color field
sequence.summary: Modern wildflower sea, golden hour. Flower bike half-swallowed by blooms. Soft backlight, pollen in the air.

sequence.title: First grain
sequence.summary: On “Daisy, Daisy…” — vertical scratches, flicker, color draining. Field begins to dissolve toward Fleet Street.

sequence.title: Scratched Fleet Street
sequence.summary: Postcard energy toward St. Paul’s. Horse traffic, bowlers. Flower bike cuts the crowd — too bright at the edges for B&W.

sequence.title: Victorian in full HD
sequence.summary: Scratches clear; color snaps back. Street stays 1890s–1910s. Living floral bicycle in crisp modern photography of old London.

sequence.title: Unstable flips
sequence.summary: On “bicycle built for two,” B&W ↔ HD a few more times — each transition less stable.

sequence.title: Soft return
sequence.summary: Modern field again as the last line lands. Fog of petals; London gone.

sights.title: Broken hansom
sights.description: One wheel missing in the gutter; the horse still standing, resigned. They pedal past without slowing.

sights.title: Wilted daisy
sights.description: Beggars on the curb. One holds up a single wilted daisy — deadpan, almost an offering or a receipt.

sights.title: Fancy closed carriage
sights.description: Opposite direction; curtains part half a second. Pure confusion at the flower bike. Curtains shut.

sights.lyricCue: You’ll look sweet upon the seat
sights.title: Stylish glance
sights.description: Women in feathered hats and walking suits (or black period bicycles). One long, amused, slightly admiring look. No dialogue.

sights.lyricCue: You’ll look sweet upon the seat
sights.title: Landau lean
sights.description: Society ladies in an open landau lean the same way at once to track the flower bicycle. Hats almost as ridiculous as the bike.

sights.title: Flower girl freezes
sights.description: Kneeling with her basket; freezes when she sees their bike *is* the flowers.

sights.title: On-the-nose headline
sights.description: Newspaper boy shouting “Bicycle Built for Two Causes Sensation!” — impossible, perfect.

sights.title: Chimney-sweep petal
sights.description: Tips his cap; a single white daisy petal drifts out of the brush.

sights.title: Lace-collar monkey
sights.description: Street organ monkey in a miniature black lace collar matching their dresses.

sights.title: Daisy hopscotch
sights.description: Children chalk hopscotch on cobbles; each square a drawn daisy face.

sights.title: Wedding lean
sights.description: Bride’s ordinary bouquet; as they pass, a few flowers lean toward the bike.

sights.title: Policeman double-take
sights.description: Full double-take, then pretends he saw nothing.

sights.title: St. Paul’s in fog
sights.description: Thick fog parts long enough for the dome, then closes behind them.

frames.title: Crowded downtown · Fleet Street
frames.description: Wide: black lace + bangs on living flower tandem through busy late-Victorian street; stylish stare, beggars on curb, St. Paul’s haze.
frames.prompt: Two young women with long black hair and bangs, pale skin and dark red lips, wearing form-fitting black lace dresses with sheer long sleeves, riding a tandem bicycle completely covered in living colorful wildflowers through a busy late-Victorian London street. Dense crowd of period pedestrians, horse-drawn carriages and hansom cabs. Stylish women in 1890s fashion with enormous leg-of-mutton sleeves, high collars, and large feathered hats turn to stare. A line of poor beggars sits along the curb. Tall brick buildings, shop signs, and the dome of St. Paul's visible in the hazy distance. Soft natural daylight mixed with slight film grain, cinematic wide shot, highly detailed.

frames.title: Transition · city thinning out
frames.description: Fewer carriages, more walkers and ordinary bikes; grass and wildflowers creep in; lace duo stays focal.
frames.prompt: Rubella and Lillith — two young women with long black hair and bangs, pale skin and dark red lips, form-fitting black lace dresses with sheer long sleeves — on a living flower-covered tandem bicycle riding along a late-Victorian London road as the dense city begins to open up. Fewer carriages, more pedestrians and ordinary bicycles. Stylish women in leg-of-mutton sleeve jackets and wide decorated hats walking or cycling past, glancing at the strange floral bike. Smaller brick houses and low walls appear on the sides. Patches of grass and wildflowers start creeping into the frame along the road edges. The two women in black lace remain the clear focal point, soft afternoon light, slight cinematic depth of field, highly detailed.

frames.title: Open road · grass and flowers
frames.description: Quieter verges, daisies and poppies; stylish woman on ordinary bike looks back; flower tandem glows against green.
frames.prompt: Wide shot of the same two gothic women with long black hair and bangs, dark red lips, form-fitting black lace dresses with sheer long sleeves, riding their tandem bicycle made entirely of blooming wildflowers down a quieter late-Victorian road on the edge of London. Smaller terraced houses and cottages line the sides. Lush grass and clusters of daisies, poppies and other wildflowers grow along the verges and between the cobbles. Other period pedestrians and a few ordinary bicycles share the road. A stylish woman in an 1890s walking suit with large puffed sleeves and a feathered hat rides past on her own bicycle and looks back. Soft golden light, gentle atmosphere, the flower bike glowing slightly against the greener surroundings, cinematic and detailed.
